Marie (Docs): Draft PR for release notes 0.11 is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4826
Marie (Docs): Need one-pass on feature callouts + 'Known issues' bullets. Target publish tomorrow EOD. PTAL @Chris (Eng) @Ashley (Product)
Chris (Eng): skimmed — looks good. please add short blurb about embedding-streaming deprecation and link to migration guide.
Ashley (Product): good call. Also SDK snippet for python streaming changed to async generator — I'll drop the updated snippet here.
Ashley (Product): ```py
async for chunk in client.stream("/generate"):
    print(chunk.text)
```
Andrew (Docs): Noted. I'll add a migration note and link to the embed migration page. Also flagging a known issue: requests with >4k tokens may see a latency spike (tracked in #4890). Add workaround?
Marie (Docs): Yes, add the workaround: suggest prefix batching + set model_timeout and link to Optimize batching doc.
Chris (Eng): small copy nit: change 'beta' -> 'preview' in the SDK headings. Also add a short note about fallback routing for Dedicated customers.
Ashley (Product): pushed commit to the PR with snippet update and rug tests passing — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4826/commits/abcd1234 :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Release draft scheduled to publish at 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC
Marie (Docs): thanks all — merging after CI. I'll also add a changelog bullet for SDK migration and an explicit Known Issue entry for the >4k latency. If anyone wants to add examples, please add them to the PR before 15:30 UTC.
